description: This PHP source file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ImportantDecorator' which decorates another attribute definition to allow for handling CSS '!important' declarations, primarily by intercepting and removing or restoring '!important' in CSS value validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ImportantDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class that manages handling of '!important' CSS declarations, wrapping another attribute definition to intercept and process '!important' during validation.

methods.name: __construct
